title: Deen - Islamic App
description:
Deen App is an all-in-one Islamic app that covers everything a Muslim needs in one place. With features like accurate prayer times, a real-time widget, Ramadan Suhoor & Iftar schedules, and a Quran Memorizer (Hifz Tracker), the app ensures you stay connected to your faith effortlessly. Explore the full Quran with audio recitation, translations, and bookmarks, along with an extensive Hadith and Dua collection. Additional tools such as the Qibla Compass, Tasbih Counter, Zakat Calculator, Hijri Calendar, Mosque Locator, and an Islamic community forum make Deen a complete lifestyle guide for Muslims worldwide. Deen App is available in multiple languages with Dark Mode & Light Mode themes.

Features:
Instant Notifications – Receive real-time notifications for all five daily prayers and special Islamic events.

Accurate Prayer Times – Get precise Salah timings, forbidden prayer periods, and sunrise/sunset schedules based on your location.

Real-time Prayer Widget – View daily prayer start and end times directly on your home screen, along with the Hijri (Arabic) date.

Ramadan Times – Get daily Suhoor & Iftar schedules, automatically adjusted to your location.

Al-Quran – Read the full Quran, categorized by Surah, Juz, page, and topic, with audio recitations by renowned reciters, English & Bangla pronunciation, advanced search, bookmarking, and sharing options.

Quran Memorizer (Hifz Tracker) – A dedicated Hifz feature to help memorize the Quran by Surah, Ayah, or Juz, with Bangla & English pronunciation and progress tracking.

Authentic Hadith Collection –Includes hadiths from Sahih Al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan An-Nasa’i, Sunan Abi Dawud, and Jami At-Tirmidhi.

Comprehensive Dua Collection – A rich collection of Dua in Arabic and meanings, categorized for daily life, protection, forgiveness, and blessings.

Qibla Direction Compass – Find the Kaaba direction accurately and quickly based on your GPS location.

Tasbih Counter (Dhikr Tracker) – A digital Tasbih tool to count Dhikr anytime, anywhere with Dhikr note-keeping functionality.

Zakat Calculator – Assess your total wealth & assets and calculate Zakat based on the Nisab threshold.

Hijri Calendar & Islamic Events – View Islamic dates and all events like Ramadan, Eid, and Ashura, with adjustable Hijri settings.

Islamic Community Forum – Engage, discuss, and share knowledge with a global Islamic community.

Mosque Locator (Masjid Finder) – Find the nearest mosque in Map instantly based on your current location.

Islamic e-Library – Access a vast collection of Islamic books, including the life stories of Prophets, with progress tracking.
Deen Education:

Asma Ul Husna – Discover the 99 Names of Allah, their meanings, and virtues.

Kalima – Learn the six Kalimas in Arabic, Bangla, and English with pronunciation.

Ayatul Kursi – Recite and memorize Ayatul Kursi in Arabic, with Bangla & English pronunciation, translation, and audio recitation.

Al-Quran (Nurani Edition) – Read a digitized version of the traditional Nurani Quran.

Ablution (Wudu) – Learn to perform Wudu, with step-by-step guidance.

Prayer Rakats Guide – Understand all Salah rakats, including Fard, Sunnah, Nafl, and Witr, with detailed explanations.

5 Pillars of Islam – A complete guide to Shahadah (Faith), Salah (Prayer), Zakat (Charity), Sawm (Fasting), and Hajj (Pilgrimage), covering their significance and practice.

Daily Hadith, Dua, & Ayah – Get a new Hadith, Dua, and Ayah displayed on your home screen every day for continuous spiritual motivation.

NOTES: We continuously add new features to improve your Islamic experience. Keep your app updated to get the latest enhancements and smoothly incorporate Islamic practices into your daily life. 

If you find any incorrect information or bugs, please email us at support@deenia.com. Insha’Allah, we will fix the issue as soon as possible.

May Allah’s grace be with you every day and everywhere. May He bless you and guide you on the path of righteousness. Ameen.
